shape.text: The access token begins shpat_. Shopify's access-token page documents the prefix and describes the rest as an opaque string with no stated length or character class.
Scanner rules read the body as 32 hexadecimal characters. The provider page does not state this.

Shopify documents offline and online access tokens as opaque strings that begin shpat_, whichever grant produced them, and states no prefix difference between the tokens of public apps and of custom apps.

collisions.text: Shopify documents the shppa_ prefix as the prefix of delegate access tokens, which derive from an app's offline access token and carry only the scopes the app specifies.
An app's client ID is a public identifier that Shopify describes as safe to include in frontend code, and it is a different value from the app's access tokens and client secret.

issuance.text: This is the access token of a custom app installed on a single store.

openQuestions.text: What are the length and alphabet of the token body?

unresolved.reason: The provider calls the body an opaque string and states no length or alphabet, and no issued token was inspected, so the body grammar cannot be established from provider evidence.

openQuestions.text: Can a shpat_ token of a custom app be told apart from a shpat_ token of a public app by its text alone?

unresolved.reason: The provider documents one shpat_ prefix for offline and online tokens and states no other difference between app types, so attributing a bare shpat_ value to custom apps is not supported by the pages read.

openQuestions.text: Does the pre-generated token of an admin-created custom app begin shpat_?

unresolved.reason: The page on admin-created custom apps states no prefix for the token, and the access-tokens page names offline and online tokens rather than these.
